this research has demonstrated the potential for robots to use tactile exploration to identify objects with a level of accuracy and robustness that is similar to humans.
we have successfully developed an intelligent tactile identification system for objects using a robotic hand.

we have developed a robot that uses tactile exploration and Bayesian exploration with reinforcement learning to identify a wide range of everyday objects with a high degree of accuracy.
we have developed a robotic system that can identify objects using a Shadow Dexterous hand and a BioTac® tactile sensor.
the combination of a Shadow hand, BioTac, and Bayesian exploration is sufficient to provide a robot with human-like tactile identification abilities.

the integration of intelligent exploration and multimodal tactile sensing can enable a robot with human-like tactile abilities.
